tldr: 🔥 Claude Opus 5 launches — near-Fable-5 intelligence at half price ($5/$25 per MTok), becomes new default on Claude Max. Anthropic also ships Claude Code Code Review (agent-driven PR reviews) and fixes quadratic slowdown in Claude Code v2.1.218. DeepSeek V4 legacy API cutoff goes into effect — deepseek-chat/reasoner retired. Alibaba Qwen drops Audio-3.0-TTS and Realtime voice models. NVIDIA open-sources Cosmos 3 Edge (4B world model for robots). Hermes Agent ships Credential Firewall for Docker sandbox security. Meituan open-sources LongCat-Video-Avatar1.5. Zo Computer adds faster chat rendering, pause/resume for services. Apple-π benchmark tests video physics reasoning. 20+ companies (Microsoft, Meta, NVIDIA, HF) sign open letter against premature open-weight model restrictions.

articles.title: Claude Opus 5 — Near-Fable-5 Intelligence at Half the Price
articles.summary: Anthropic launches Opus 5 at $5/$25 per MTok. New default on Claude Max. Mid-conversation tool changes and automatic fallbacks in beta.

articles.title: Claude Code Code Review — Agent-driven PR Reviews
articles.summary: A team of Claude Code agents runs deep reviews on every PR. Anthropic engineers saw 200% code output increase — reviews were the bottleneck.

articles.title: Claude Code 2.1.216-218 — Quadratic Slowdown Fixed
articles.summary: Major fix: normalization O(n) instead of O(n²) in auto-mode sessions. New sandbox.filesystem.disabled config, OAuth token rotation fix.

articles.title: Claude Cookbook — Platform Cookbook Launched
articles.summary: Anthropic launches developer cookbook with recipes and examples. 166 HN points, 82 comments.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 Legacy API Cutoff — deepseek-chat/reasoner Retired
articles.summary: Hard cutoff at 15:59 UTC Jul 24. All API users must migrate to deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash. No fallback routing.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS — Studio-Grade Text-to-Speech
articles.summary: Two flavors: Flash for real-time interaction, Plus for high-quality. Inline emotion tags ([whisper], [angry], [laughs]), natural language control.

articles.title: Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime — Conversational Voice with Tools
articles.summary: Real-time conversational model with complex reasoning, agent tool integration. Supports 16 languages, 20 Chinese dialects.

articles.title: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Edge — Open 4B World Model for Robots
articles.summary: Open-weight 4B parameter world model for edge robotics and vision AI. Real-time reasoning on devices.

articles.title: Hermes Agent Credential Firewall for Docker Sandboxes
articles.summary: Real keys never enter Docker sandbox — stand-in tokens only. Compromised sandbox tokens are useless elsewhere.

articles.title: Hermes Agent tldraw Offline Skill
articles.summary: Reads open tldraw canvas, edits it live, embeds scripts with working buttons and state. Install: hermes skills install tldraw-offline.

articles.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-Video-Avatar1.5
articles.summary: Video avatar model outperforming mainstream closed-source alternatives. Open weights released on Hugging Face.

articles.title: Apple-π Benchmark — Video Physics Reasoning with Formal Logic
articles.summary: New benchmark for video models' understanding of physics grounded in formal logic law constraints.

articles.title: AMAP's ABot-World-0 — Interactive Video World Model on RTX 5090
articles.summary: Action-controlled video world model. 5B params, runs on single RTX 5090. Apache 2.0 weights, interactive inference.

articles.title: Dario Amodei Urges Global AI Unity at G7 Summit
articles.summary: Called for resisting splintering of AI ecosystem amid US export bans on Chinese AI chips.

articles.title: 20+ Companies Sign Open Letter Against Premature Open-Weight Restrictions
articles.summary: Microsoft, Meta, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, Palantir urge policymakers to distinguish legitimate distillation from misappropriation.

articles.title: Zo Computer — Faster Chat, Pause/Resume, Improved Memory
articles.summary: Rebuilt rendering pipeline for smooth streaming in long convos. Pause/resume hosted services. Improved memory on paid plans.

articles.title: German AI Consortium Releases Soofi S — Open 30B Model
articles.summary: Tops benchmarks in English and German but caught with GPQA benchmark contamination in training data by community audit.

articles.title: Clem Delangue Heads to SF Over Hugging Face 'Rogue Agent' Incident
articles.summary: HF CEO flies to SF to meet OpenAI about GPT-5.6 Sol autonomous breach. Thanks Z.ai/GLM 5.2 for defense. 91.9K views.

articles.title: Garry Tan: Graph Retrieval for Legal AI Beyond Context Windows
articles.summary: Harvey's post-training team working on KV cache compaction for 256k-1M context. Graph retrieval as alternative to context window scaling.
